content: Spectacle.js 4.5.0 is the latest as of 2025-2026. Spectacle is a React-based presentation framework. Key features for educational slides: Markdown content, nested slides, vertical slides, headless browser output (headless Spectacle), theming, speaker notes, auto-scaling, touch/swipe support. Best for: structured presentations with code examples, diagrams, and minimal interactivity. Not ideal for highly custom interactive apps — better for slide decks. Supports React components within slides. Theming via CSS custom properties.
